# looot-n8n-workflows

> Importable n8n workflows for GTM data, built only on core n8n nodes: work email waterfall with verification, company research card, signup qualifier with ICP score, daily Google rank check. Built on the looot API.

looot is one key and one prepaid balance for 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers. Each job run falls back across providers within a cost cap; a failed call costs $0.

## Use

- Download workflows/<name>/workflow.json from https://github.com/loootai/looot-n8n-workflows and import it in n8n.
- Credential: Header Auth named "looot API", Authorization = Bearer <looot token>.

## Links

- Docs: https://docs.looot.ai
- n8n community node: https://github.com/loootai/n8n-nodes-looot
- GTM tools list: https://github.com/loootai/awesome-gtm
